title: In vivo and in silico assessments of estrogenic potencies of bisphenol A and its analogs in zebrafish (Danio rerio): Validity of in silico approaches to predict in vivo effects.
authors: Kubota, Akira; Hirano, Masashi; Yoshinouchi, Yuka; Chen, Xing; Nakamura, Michiko; Wakayama, Yumi; Lee, Jae Seung; Nakata, Haruhiko; Iwata, Hisato; Kawai, Yusuke K
journal: Comparative biochemistry and physiology. Toxicology & pharmacology : CBP
one_liner_zh: 该研究结合体内斑马鱼实验与分子对接模拟评估双酚A类似物的雌激素效力，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接，但对象为核受体而非TF-DNA互作，方法上仅简单对接无AI/物理模拟创新，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: This study assessed the estrogen-like potencies of bisphenol A (BPA) and its analogs (BPs) using in vivo and in silico approaches in zebrafish. Zebrafish embryos were exposed to 16 BPs, most of which concentration-dependently induced cytochrome P450 19A1b (CYP19A1b) expression. BPs-induced CYP19A1b expression was suppressed by fulvestrant, a nonselective high affinity antagonist for estrogen receptor (Esr) subtypes. For BPs that concentration-dependently induced CYP19A1b expression, we estimated their 50 % effective concentration (EC(50)) and relative potencies (REPs) with respect to the potency of BPA for inducing CYP19A1b expression. BP C2, Bis-MP, and BPAF showed lower EC(50) than BPA, BPE, and BPF, while BPZ and BPB showed moderate EC(50). The REP order of the BPs was BP C2 (26) > Bis-MP (24) > BPAF (21) > BPZ (5.8) > BPB (2.7) > BPE (1.5) > BPF (0.63) > 2,4'-BPF (0.22), indicating that some BPs showed greater estrogenic potencies than BPA in our system. We also constructed in silico homology models of ligand binding domains for zebrafish Esr subtypes, including Esr1, Esr2a, and Esr2b. Molecular docking simulations of ligands with the Esr subtypes revealed the interaction energies of some BPs were lower than that of BPA. The interaction energies showed significant positive correlations with their EC(50) values for inducing CYP19A1b expression in vivo. This study showed that some BPA analogs have greater estrogenic potencies than BPA and that in silico simulations of interactions between ligands and Esr subtypes may help predict in vivo estrogenic potencies of untested chemicals.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用体内和计算机模拟方法，评估了双酚A（BPA）及其类似物（BPs）在斑马鱼中的雌激素样效力。将斑马鱼胚胎暴露于16种BPs，其中大多数浓度依赖性地诱导了细胞色素P450 19A1b（CYP19A1b）表达。BPs诱导的CYP19A1b表达被氟维司群（一种非选择性高亲和力雌激素受体（Esr）亚型拮抗剂）抑制。对于浓度依赖性诱导CYP19A1b表达的BPs，我们估计了其50%有效浓度（EC(50)）及相对于BPA诱导CYP19A1b表达效力的相对效力（REPs）。BP C2、Bis-MP和BPAF的EC(50)低于BPA、BPE和BPF，而BPZ和BPB的EC(50)适中。BPs的REP顺序为BP C2 (26) > Bis-MP (24) > BPAF (21) > BPZ (5.8) > BPB (2.7) > BPE (1.5) > BPF (0.63) > 2,4'-BPF (0.22)，表明在我们的系统中，一些BPs显示出比BPA更高的雌激素效力。我们还构建了斑马鱼Esr亚型（包括Esr1、Esr2a和Esr2b）配体结合域的计算机模拟同源模型。配体与Esr亚型的分子对接模拟显示，一些BPs的相互作用能量低于BPA。相互作用能量与体内诱导CYP19A1b表达的EC(50)值呈显著正相关。本研究表明，一些BPA类似物具有比BPA更高的雌激素效力，且配体与Esr亚型相互作用的计算机模拟可能有助于预测未经测试化学品的体内雌激素效力。
